## Summary

lookahead in `CombineFlag\(\)` and number/Roman-number handling, so those
paths do not keep reading adjacent `wtab` entries without knowing how
many initialized entries remain.

Finding 2 (CWE-787): `dictionary_skipwords` can be used as an unchecked offset into `words[N_CLAUSE_WORDS]` in `TranslateClauseWithTerminator()`. This patch guards the sink so an out-of-range skip count is cleared instead of writing past the initialized word range. Finding 3 (CWE-125 / CWE-457): `LookupDict2()` receives a `WORD_TAB *wtab` but no remaining initialized word count. Multi-word dictionary lookahead can therefore read past the initialized `words[]` range near the end of a clause. This patch threads an explicit `wtab_remaining` count from `TranslateClauseWithTerminator()` through `TranslateWord2()`, `TranslateWord3()`, `LookupDictList()`, and `LookupDict2()`. The public `TranslateWord()` signature is unchanged. fix: three memory safety issues in text parsing (#2428)

## Summary

This fixes three reported memory-safety issues in the text translation
path.

Reported by Jiami Lin.

Finding 1 (CWE-121 / CWE-787): `CheckDottedAbbrev()` copies UTF-8 bytes
into a fixed 80-byte stack buffer without checking the total number of
bytes already copied. This patch adds a byte-count guard before copying
each abbreviation segment.

Finding 2 (CWE-787): `dictionary_skipwords` can be used as an unchecked
offset into `words[N_CLAUSE_WORDS]` in
`TranslateClauseWithTerminator()`. This patch guards the sink so an
out-of-range skip count is cleared instead of writing past the
initialized word range.

Finding 3 (CWE-125 / CWE-457): `LookupDict2()` receives a `WORD_TAB
*wtab` but no remaining initialized word count. Multi-word dictionary
lookahead can therefore read past the initialized `words[]` range near
the end of a clause. This patch threads an explicit `wtab_remaining`
count from `TranslateClauseWithTerminator()` through `TranslateWord2()`,
`TranslateWord3()`, `LookupDictList()`, and `LookupDict2()`.

The public `TranslateWord()` signature is unchanged.

The same bounded `WORD_TAB` context is also used for related internal
lookahead in `CombineFlag()` and number/Roman-number handling, so those
paths do not keep reading adjacent `wtab` entries without knowing how
many initialized entries remain.

## Tests

- Added crash vectors for the dotted-abbreviation stack overwrite,
`dictionary_skipwords` sink, and `LookupDict2()` boundary lookahead
cases.
- `ctest --test-dir /tmp/build-final-ctest -j"$(nproc)"
--output-on-failure`: 19/19 passed.
- ASan/UBSan checks for `translate`, `crash`,
`language-numbers-cardinal`, and `language-numbers-ordinal`: passed.
- Original PoC rechecks: Finding 1 no longer aborts, Finding 2 no longer
hits an out-of-bounds `words[]` sink in GDB, and Finding 3 plain/strong
comparison outputs are equal.

Read Sinhala ZWJ conjunct clusters as a single conjunct

Sinhala touching conjuncts (e.g. ක්‍ර) are encoded as consonant + virama
(U+0DCA) + zero-width-joiner (U+200D) + consonant. The ZWJ only selects a
touching-conjunct glyph and has no effect on pronunciation, but it was not
ignored for Sinhala, so the cluster was split: ක්‍ර produced "k r@" instead
of the blended "kra", and a word such as ක්‍රියාකාරීන් came out as
"k r'ija...".

Mirror the existing Malayalam virama+ZWJ handling in ReadClause: when the
Sinhala virama is followed by a ZWJ, consume the joiner so the cluster is
read as one conjunct. The trigger is gated on the Sinhala virama codepoint,
so emoji ZWJ sequences (joiner follows an emoji, not the virama) are
unaffected. Update the Sinhala pronunciation test accordingly.

fix: three memory safety issues in text parsing (#2428)

## Summary

This fixes three reported memory-safety issues in the text translation
path.

Reported by Jiami Lin.

Finding 1 (CWE-121 / CWE-787): `CheckDottedAbbrev()` copies UTF-8 bytes
into a fixed 80-byte stack buffer without checking the total number of
bytes already copied. This patch adds a byte-count guard before copying
each abbreviation segment.

Finding 2 (CWE-787): `dictionary_skipwords` can be used as an unchecked
offset into `words[N_CLAUSE_WORDS]` in
`TranslateClauseWithTerminator()`. This patch guards the sink so an
out-of-range skip count is cleared instead of writing past the
initialized word range.

Finding 3 (CWE-125 / CWE-457): `LookupDict2()` receives a `WORD_TAB
*wtab` but no remaining initialized word count. Multi-word dictionary
lookahead can therefore read past the initialized `words[]` range near
the end of a clause. This patch threads an explicit `wtab_remaining`
count from `TranslateClauseWithTerminator()` through `TranslateWord2()`,
`TranslateWord3()`, `LookupDictList()`, and `LookupDict2()`.

The public `TranslateWord()` signature is unchanged.

The same bounded `WORD_TAB` context is also used for related internal
lookahead in `CombineFlag()` and number/Roman-number handling, so those
paths do not keep reading adjacent `wtab` entries without knowing how
many initialized entries remain.

## Tests

- Added crash vectors for the dotted-abbreviation stack overwrite,
`dictionary_skipwords` sink, and `LookupDict2()` boundary lookahead
cases.
- `ctest --test-dir /tmp/build-final-ctest -j"$(nproc)"
--output-on-failure`: 19/19 passed.
- ASan/UBSan checks for `translate`, `crash`,
`language-numbers-cardinal`, and `language-numbers-ordinal`: passed.
- Original PoC rechecks: Finding 1 no longer aborts, Finding 2 no longer
hits an out-of-bounds `words[]` sink in GDB, and Finding 3 plain/strong
comparison outputs are equal.

name.value: Read Sinhala ZWJ conjunct clusters as a single conjunct

value.value: Read Sinhala ZWJ conjunct clusters as a single conjunct

Read Sinhala ZWJ conjunct clusters as a single conjunct

Sinhala touching conjuncts (e.g. ක්‍ර) are encoded as consonant + virama
(U+0DCA) + zero-width-joiner (U+200D) + consonant. The ZWJ only selects a
touching-conjunct glyph and has no effect on pronunciation, but it was not
ignored for Sinhala, so the cluster was split: ක්‍ර produced "k r@" instead
of the blended "kra", and a word such as ක්‍රියාකාරීන් came out as
"k r'ija...".

Mirror the existing Malayalam virama+ZWJ handling in ReadClause: when the
Sinhala virama is followed by a ZWJ, consume the joiner so the cluster is
read as one conjunct. The trigger is gated on the Sinhala virama codepoint,
so emoji ZWJ sequences (joiner follows an emoji, not the virama) are
unaffected. Update the Sinhala pronunciation test accordingly.

Mark re-used buffers as undefined

These are global arrays reused several times. When using them msan and
valgrind thus believe they are always initialized, which reduces their
capacity to detect uninitialized values. We can however explicitly tell them
when they are reused, and thus to be considered as uninitialized.
